usage: agentbreeder deploy [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json] (--local |
                           --cluster) [--environment ENVIRONMENT]
                           [--project DIR] [--stack DIR]
                           manifest

positional arguments:
  manifest

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --local               Target: local Docker
  --cluster             Target: Kubernetes
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        Operator-defined environment name
  --project DIR         With agent/NAME@X.Y.Z: the project whose ./registry
                        holds it (default: .)
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
